section_path: Thymus and Other Endocrine Glands (excluding Adrenal Gland, Pituitary Gland, Craniopharyngeal Duct, and Pineal Gland
text:
C379  Thymus
C750  Parathyroid gland
C754  Carotid body
C755  Aortic body and other paraganglia
C758  Overlapping lesion of endocrine glands and related structures
C759  Endocrine gland, NOS

**Note 1:**  Laterality must be coded for C754.

**Note 2:** TNM is not defined for this schema. If directly assigning Summary Stage 2000 (SS2000), use the *Thymus, Adrenal (Suprarenal) Gland and Other Endocrine Glands* chapter on page 278 of the [SS2000 on-line manual](https://seer.cancer.gov/tools/ssm/ssm2000/SSSM2000-122012.pdf#page=278).
